classification.difficultyReason: Apply the explicitly supplied decrease of two from negative one, continuing leftward through negative integers.

content.prompt: The sequence $3,1,-1,\ldots$ is ‘going down by twos’. Write down the next three terms. (Draw a number line to help you.)

answer.worked:
Move two units to the left for each new term:

$$\begin{align*}-1-2&=-3\\-3-2&=-5\\-5-2&=-7\end{align*}$$

The next three terms are $-3,-5,-7$.
